description: Read the enabled permission operations (`autoSettings.permitOperations`) for the authenticated user. Returns `{ permitOperations: string[] }` — use it before mutating auto-sell or auto-buy rules to confirm the action is allowed for the wallet. Requires a signature session and `mcp-session-id`. Read-only and idempotent.
name: tronsave_get_user_permissions

permitOperations.description: Permission rows enabled for this user; defaults to `[]` when nothing is configured.

id.description: Backend-assigned permission row id; null when not yet persisted.

operations.description: Numeric operation codes enabled for this row; semantics defined by the backend.

permissionName.description: Human-readable permission name; meant for display rather than equality checks.

type.description: Permission category as labelled by the backend (e.g. role/scope tag).

title: User Permissions
